svg.title: AWS original storage and clean-read gate
svg.desc: Django reserves relational identity, uploads an immutable original to private S3, then admits queued work. EventBridge integrates GuardDuty scanning. Only clean-tagged originals can be retrieved by the worker or owner download. The worker saves the report to RDS; UI reads it through Django.
svg.text: AWS: retain the original, release only a clean source
Terraform-defined · not deployed · expands business steps 2, 5, 6 and 7
PUT original; then job + outbox commit
S3 object event reaches managed rule
Starts scan independently of the API
Write scan-result tag to that object
Wait for scan; verify original checksum
Fence current lease; save one report
Original download uses same clean gate
Application roles cannot forge scan tags. Scanner permissions are separate from app/worker roles.
Owner deletion/expiry blocks access first; durable reconciliation removes objects and derived records.
Local counterpart: SeaweedFS + ClamAV. It does not emulate GuardDuty, IAM or KMS.
